title: Jujutsu Kaisen
description: Yuji Itadori is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a classmate who has been attacked by curses, he eats the finger of Ryomen Sukuna, taking the curse into his own soul. From then on, he shares one body with Ryomen Sukuna. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Satoru Gojo, Itadori is admitted to Tokyo Jujutsu High School, an organization that fights the curses… and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a curse to exorcise a curse, a life from which he could never turn back.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: After visiting his beloved grandfather in the hospital, Yuji Itadori encounters an apprentice sorcerer who demands that Yuji hand over a cursed relic.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Yuji manages to control the curse of Ryomen Sukuna. Later, he awakens in a room with Jujutsu High teacher Satoru Gojo, who offers him a deadly choice.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Nobara Kugisaki joins the class on a trip to Roppongi where Gojo gives her and Yuji their first test: dispel a curse from an abandoned building.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: When a curse womb attacks a juvenile detention center, Yuji's group is called upon to rescue any remaining survivors — but combat isn’t an option.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: As Sukuna gruesomely holds Yuji's body hostage, Fushiguro struggles against the sheer strength of Sukuna's curse to buy time until Yuji can awaken.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Sukuna tells Yuji that he will bring him back to life on two conditions. Meanwhile, Suguru Geto and a cursed spirit discuss their plans for Gojo.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: The cursed spirit Jogo attacks Gojo, who has such little trouble fighting back that he leaves and brings back a student to observe the battle.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: As Kugisaki and Fushiguro train for the exchange event, two older students from the Kyoto Jujutsu school arrive in Tokyo and pick a fight with them.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: High schooler Junpei Yoshino finds his bullies horrifically killed in a movie theater. Sorcerer Kento Nanami and Yuji investigate the crime scene.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Junpei gets some startling advice from Mahito. Later, Ijichi and Yuji track down Junpei and formulate a plan to set up a chance encounter with him.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Annoyed at having to work off the clock, Nanami shows Mahito the true potential of his sorcery. Meanwhile, Yuji and Junpei bond over movies.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Ignoring Nanami's warning, Yuji dashes into the school and tries to reason with Junpei, but Mahito soon interrupts. Yuji appeals to Sukuna for help.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Yuji and Nanami coordinate their attacks on Mahito, wearing him down. But as the cursed spirit approaches death, he finds a new power within himself.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: With the exchange event between the Tokyo and Kyoto Jujutsu schools set to begin, Gojo arranges for Yuji to make a surprise appearance.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Shortly after the exchange event team battle begins, Todo ambushes the Tokyo students. Yuji moves to stop him but soon finds himself surrounded.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Todo gives Yuji advice on how to better tap into his curse powers. After Kugisaki taunts Nishimiya, Panda fights the remote-controlled Mechamaru.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: While Miwa struggles to stand her ground against Maki's attacks, Kugisaki chases down a flying Nishimiya, who lectures her about Mai's hardships.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Fushiguro dodges Kamo's barrage of arrows but his opponent proves just as formidable in close combat. Meanwhile, Inumaki senses a foreboding presence.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Inumaki, Fushiguro and Kamo struggle to hold their own against special grade cursed spirit Hanami, but Maki arrives to provide much-needed backup.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: After analyzing Hanami's assortment of skills with his self-proclaimed intellect, Todo uses his disorienting technique to attack in tandem with Yuji.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: After the event's interruption, the school tournament continues with a baseball match.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: An investigation into a string of curse-related killings leads Yuji, Fushiguro and Kugisaki to the victims' – and Fushiguro's – former middle school.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Fushiguro, Kugisaki and Itadori fight the cursed spirits on two fronts. When Fushiguro faces his enemy alone, he recalls his recent training with Gojo. He knows that he has to be able to surpass himself...

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Yuji and Nobara's battle against the Death Painting Wombs Kechizu and Eso reaches its conclusion! However, even in victory there is a cost in killing, something the Jujutsu High students had never considered before. Meanwhile, Choso, Geto and Mahito gain wind of this event.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Yuji's group enters two of the colonies and fight the Culling Game's newbie hunters.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Yuji meets Higuruma and tries to persuade him, while Fushiguro is falsely led to Reggie.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Yuji Itadori fights Hiromi Higuruma.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Takaba handles the minions while Fushiguro has his showdown with Reggie.

episodes_data.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Fushiguro deploys his Domain Expansion in his climatic fight against Reggie.
